resources.string: Sotreus shows what this phone can observe over Bluetooth LE and Wi-Fi, learns what is normal for a place, and remembers what you have encountered before.
No account. Your radio history stays on this phone.
Sotreus listens to broadcasts. It never pairs, joins or interferes.
A radio being present does not prove surveillance, intent or ownership. You decide what it means.
What Sotreus can and can’t see
Nothing here needs sign-in. You can add a profile later in Settings.
Android only hands scan results to apps with these permissions. Sotreus asks for what Now uses — nothing else yet.
Read Bluetooth LE advertisements. Sotreus never pairs or connects.
Read visible access-point beacons. Sotreus never joins a network.
Android withholds Wi-Fi and BLE results without it. Your path is recorded only if you start a geotagged Journey.
A status notice while observation runs in the background.
Bluetooth advertise — only if you turn on Nearby presence. Background location — not used in this version.
Android will not ask again. Open app settings to allow it.
Location is off. Android needs it on for Wi-Fi and BLE scan results.
Sotreus reports what this phone can observe. It cannot prove why a radio is there.

Bluetooth LE advertisements and visible Wi-Fi access points that this phone’s radios receive, with their signal strength and timing. Classification comes from what each radio broadcasts, matched against a device-family catalog.

Radios that are off, asleep, out of range or not advertising. Classic Bluetooth, cellular, Wi-Fi client traffic, encrypted content, and any band Android does not expose. Android also limits Wi-Fi scans to 4 every 2 minutes, so Wi-Fi results are often seconds old.
Signal strength suggests proximity only. Bodies, bags and walls change readings as much as distance does. Signal strength is not distance and not direction.
Many radios use random addresses that change. A name or family match is a pattern in the broadcast, not proof of what the device is, who owns it or why it is nearby.
Observations, places, labels and notes stay on this phone. Sotreus has no observation server. Exports are privacy-reduced unless you choose otherwise.
Radio parsing, device explanations, the signature catalog and proximity logic are ported from Fieldwatch (MIT, Off Grid Pete LLC). Fonts: Geist, Geist Mono and Instrument Serif (SIL OFL).
